data_source.symbol_type: parent symbology: every MES contract (outrights + calendar spreads); front month is built in load.py
data_source.notes: Convert ts_event from UTC to America/New_York BEFORE any session logic. Volume profile is built from 1-min bars; strategy runs on 5-min RTH resample. Raw contracts, not a continuous symbol: load.py drops spreads and selects the front month per instrument.
data_source.symbols: one raw file per instrument in data/raw/ (MES, MNQ); load.py reads every file and keeps each instrument's outrights by root symbol

account.drawdown_model: EOD trailing (lock rule: VERIFY on Lucid help center)
account.note: Switched from LucidFlex 25K on 2026-11-10 at 4 trials. Consistency rule, daily loss stop and payout terms carried over from the 25K notes are UNVERIFIED for the 100K: check Lucid's help center before funding. Backtests stay at 1 contract; P&L and drawdown scale linearly with contracts.

training.note: the first training read (phase 5) and the only window looked at while building; also wf1's train period

oos_holdout.note: calendar 2026 only, run ONCE at the very end; walk-forward windows unchanged (last test window = 2025)

validation.regime_split: volatility terciles (realized vol of MES or VIX)

regime.note: terciles of lagged rolling realized vol of RTH close-to-close returns, cut points from development data only

validation.holdout_ledger: results/holdout_ledger.jsonl (who consumed the holdout, when, at which commit)

trial_budget.advance_rule: trials 11-15: a strategy advances only with net expectancy > 0 on training AND, on the pooled walk-forward test trades, net expectancy > 0 with t >= 3.0 and a majority of windows positive. The bar was raised with the budget: more trials, more false positives.
trial_budget.stopping_rule: if nothing clears all four gates on walk-forward within the budget, the conclusion is: no edge I can build trades often enough and survives costs on a $1,000 buffer. Nothing is funded.

contract_roll.front_rule: volume crossover: the front for session D+1 is the contract with the most volume in session D, never an earlier expiry than the current front
contract_roll.session_date: Globex trading day, 18:00 ET (prior evening) to 17:00 ET
contract_roll.skip_reason: the strategy is level-based; shifting or back-adjusting levels across contracts corrupts the profile
